name: evaluation-brief
title: Tender evaluation brief
for_each: select id,reference from tenders order by reference

sections.title: Required lots
sections.sql: select reference,name,quantity,unit from lots where tender_id=$1 order by reference

sections.title: Offer comparison
sections.sql: select supplier,currency,total,max_lead_days,weighted_score,open_questions from comparison where tender_id=$1 order by supplier

sections.title: Criteria
sections.sql: select name,weight from criteria where tender_id=$1 order by name

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select rule,issue from compliance_checks where tender_id=$1 order by rule

name: probity-record
title: Evaluation declarations and evidence
for_each: select id,reference from tenders order by reference

sections.title: Panel declarations
sections.sql: select name,declaration,evidence from panel where tender_id=$1 order by name

sections.title: Recorded scores
sections.sql: select s.name supplier,c.name criterion,p.name reviewer,sc.value,sc.rationale from scores sc join suppliers s on s.id=sc.supplier_id join criteria c on c.id=sc.criterion_id join panel p on p.id=sc.panel_id where sc.tender_id=$1 order by s.name,c.name,p.name

sections.title: Clarifications
sections.sql: select reference,question,owner,due_on,answer,evidence from clarifications where tender_id=$1 order by reference

name: award-record
title: Recorded award decision
for_each: select t.id,t.reference from tenders t join decisions d on d.tender_id=t.id

sections.title: Decision
sections.sql: select s.name supplier,d.approved_by,d.rationale,d.evidence,d.created_at from decisions d join suppliers s on s.id=d.supplier_id where d.tender_id=$1

sections.title: Frozen evaluation snapshot
sections.note: An internal record of a human approval. This document sends no award or contract.
sections.sql: select snapshot from decisions where tender_id=$1
